instruction: Create a Makefile for common project tasks
output:
cat > Makefile << 'EOF'
.PHONY: build test clean
build:
	echo Building...
test:
	echo Running tests...
clean:
	rm -rf dist/
EOF

instruction: Run a Makefile target
Run a Makefile target with variables
Create a Makefile with dependencies
output:
cat > Makefile << 'EOF'
all: build test
build: deps
	gcc -o app main.c
deps:
	@echo Checking deps...
test:
	./app --test
EOF

instruction: Use autotools: create a configure.ac
output:
cat > configure.ac << 'EOF'
AC_INIT([myapp], [1.0], [myemail@example.com])
AM_INIT_AUTOMAKE
AC_PROG_CC
AC_CONFIG_FILES([Makefile])
AC_OUTPUT
EOF

instruction: Generate configure script from configure.ac
Create a systemd service unit file
output:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/myapp.service << 'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=My Custom App
After=network.target
[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/myapp
Restart=always
User=nobody
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF && systemctl daemon-reload

instruction: Create a systemd timer for a service
output:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/myapp.timer << 'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Run myapp daily
[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 02:00:00
Persistent=true
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
EOF && systemctl enable --now myapp.timer

instruction: Create a systemd path unit to watch a directory
output:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/watch.path << 'EOF'
[Path]
PathChanged=/var/spool/upload
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF && systemctl enable --now watch.path

instruction: Install and configure uWSGI for Python apps
output:
apt install -y uwsgi uwsgi-plugin-python3 && cat > /etc/uwsgi/apps-available/myapp.ini << 'EOF'
[uwsgi]
chdir = /var/www/myapp
module = app
callable = app
socket = /run/uwsgi/myapp.sock
processes = 4
EOF && ln -s /etc/uwsgi/apps-available/myapp.ini /etc/uwsgi/apps-enabled/ && systemctl restart uwsgi

instruction: Install gunicorn for Python web apps
Create a gunicorn systemd service
output:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/gunicorn.service << 'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Gunicorn Python App
[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/gunicorn --bind 0.0.0.0:8000 app:app
Restart=always
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF && systemctl enable --now gunicorn
